latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of iplat-test-skill for 京东国际物流数据查询.

- Supports real-time tracking for various international logistics tracking numbers.
- Enables querying and comparative analysis of a wide range of supply chain and cross-border package KPIs.
- Integrates logistics trajectory tracking and operational indicators into one skill.
